description: PANDA is an informational plugin that helps you explore pet insurance costs. Enter a few basic details about your pet (species, breed, age, size) to see illustrative, non-binding price estimates based on PANDA's tariff logic. Compare plan options side by side to understand how coverage levels and premiums typically relate. These are estimates only, not a quote, offer, or binding coverage — actual pricing, eligibility, and terms are determined by PANDA/InterRisk Versicherungs-AG after a full application and review. PANDA does not approve or deny coverage, issue policies, or provide personalized insurance advice; for a binding quote or to purchase a policy, please visit panda-tierversicherung.com.
